about.title: Dance in the air
paragraphs: This project was born a few years ago, dreaming together with friends about trying new aerial experiences.
About the chance to fly and play with heights...
About creating a space for creativity and bringing in new apparatus we are passionate about.
With a lot of effort, planning and the motivation of my friends, who are always there imagining new possibilities, AERIAL EXPERIENCE was born, and 2 years later we launched the second edition.
So that you can feel free to express yourselves. We want AERIAL EXPERIENCE to be a refuge for free expression, where each person can discover their own way of flying and feel completely free.
I am deeply grateful to everyone who has supported us on this exciting journey, and I invite you to join us in October to enjoy together this experience we have built with love.
about.closing: I can't wait to fly high and explore new apparatus with you!

coach.title: Hi, I'm Aldi
coach.photoAlt: Aldi, Aerial Coach at Aerial Experience
paragraphs: I'm an Aerial Coach and aerial acrobatics instructor with more than 10 years of experience in aerial disciplines. My passion for movement led me to explore and teach different techniques, always looking for new ways to challenge the body, build skills and enjoy the process.
I teach Aerial Straps, Static Trapeze, Dance Trapeze, Aerial Silks, Aerial Hammock, Aerial Hoop and other aerial disciplines, adapting every session to each student's level, goals and needs.
My approach combines strength, flexibility, technique and body awareness, but it also sees training as a tool to build confidence, push past limits and connect with yourself.
I believe in enthusiastic, innovative and personalised teaching, where everyone can progress at their own pace, discover their potential and enjoy movement.
My goal is for every student not only to develop new aerial skills, but also to feel a physical and emotional change, building strength, safety, confidence and a deeper connection with their body.

disciplines.title: Choose your apparatus
disciplines.straps: Two suspended straps that challenge your strength, control and precision. We work on pulls, rotations and dynamic figures, building a solid shoulder and core foundation step by step.
disciplines.trapeze: Dance trapeze brings flight and choreographic movement together. Swings, spins and flowing transitions on the bar and ropes, where technique becomes expression.
disciplines.hammock: A fabric hammock that holds you and invites you to explore. Ideal for beginners: inversions, wraps and gentle drops, combining strength, flexibility and plenty of confidence.
